abandon.definition: If you abandon something, you go away from it with no plan to return.
abandon.sentence: Many teens abandon all chances of a successful future when they drop out of school.

ability.definition: An ability is something that you can do.
ability.sentence: I have a very good reading ability.

able.definition: If someone is able to do something, they can do it.
able.sentence: I'm busy tomorrow, so I won't be able to see you.

about.definition: If something is about to happen, it will happen very soon.
about.sentence: Please be seated. We're about to begin.

above.definition: In or to a place that is higher.

abroad.definition: To or in a foreign country.

absence.definition: Absence is when something is not there.
absence.sentence: There was an absence of help for the project.

absolute.definition: An absolute is something that will always exist.
absolute.sentence: No mortal being can influence the absolute.

absolutely.definition: If something is absolutely true, correct, etc., it's 100% so.

abstract.definition: If something is abstract, you cannot touch it, and it is difficult to imagine or think about.
abstract.sentence: A lot of abstract painting uses harsh shapes and most people do not like it.

academic.definition: An academic topic, lecture, idea, etc., is one that is connected to education.
academic.sentence: The academic staff at the college generally don't teach during the summer.

accept.definition: If you accept something, you take it when somebody gives it to you.

acceptable.definition: When something is acceptable it is capable of being accepted or is worth being accepted.
acceptable.sentence: You ideas are acceptable to the group.

access.definition: If you have access to something, you can use it, look at it, enter it, etc.
access.sentence: As a student, you have access to all our facilities including the library and computers.

accident.definition: Accident means something that happens without a plan; unintentionally; inadvertently.
accident.sentence: I dropped the glass by accident and it broke.

accommodation.definition: Accommodation is the process or result of changing something to fit a particular need or situation.
accommodation.sentence: The hotel provides high quality accommodation, mostly for foreign visitors.

accompany.definition: If one thing accompanies something else, it comes or goes with it, or they happen together.

accomplish.definition: If you accomplish something, you succeed in doing or completing something.

accord.definition: If two or more things are in accord, they match or agree.
accord.sentence: We are in accord that the bridge should be built.

account.definition: An account is an arrangement with a bank or other company to do business.
account.sentence: I opened a bank account when I moved into town.

accurate.definition: Something accurate is correct or exact.
accurate.sentence: We need to provide people with more accurate information.

accuse.definition: If you accuse someone, you say they did something, usually something bad.

achieve.definition: If you achieve success or a goal, you have completed what you planned to do or have a good result.

achievement.definition: An achievement is something that is or was achieved.
achievement.sentence: Winning a championship is a great achievement.

acknowledge.definition: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.
acknowledge.sentence: I should be grateful if you would acknowledge receipt of this letter.

acquire.definition: If you acquire something, you buy or get it.
acquire.sentence: Children acquire language at an amazing rate.

acquisition.definition: Acquisition is the act of getting something, often by buying it.
acquisition.sentence: The judge ruled that the acquisition of XYZ company by Acme Inc. was illegal.

across.sentence: The marble slabs were cut across.

act.definition: If you act in some way, you do something that makes people think you are that way.
act.sentence: Don't do anything strange. Just act normal.

action.definition: An action is something that you do, or something that happens, especially with motion.
action.sentence: The Health Authority is preparing to take legal action against the restaurants that fail to follow the regulations.

active.definition: Something is active if it is turned on or started.
active.sentence: Jenkins is an active member of the Rotary Club since he goes to all the meetings.

activity.definition: When a person or animal has activity, it is active or lively.
activity.sentence: The sleeping dog did not show much activity.

actor.definition: An actor is a person (usually male) who performs as a character in a play or other theatrical work. A female performer is called either an actress or an actor.
actor.sentence: The actor received a Tony Award.

actual.definition: An actual thing is one that exists; it is real.
actual.sentence: People call me Peter, but my actual name is Pierre.

actually.definition: You use actually to say that something is real; in fact; really.
actually.sentence: Actually, I had nothing to do with that incident.

ad.definition: A short way of saying advertisement.
ad.sentence: I saw an ad in the newspaper for a job at the factory.

adapt.definition: If you adapt to changes, conditions, needs, etc., you change to fit them.
adapt.sentence: It was difficult to adapt to the changes, but I work much better now.

add.definition: If you add x to y, you put x and y together.
add.sentence: A new kitchen would add value to the home.

addition.definition: The part of arithmetic where numbers are added together.

additional.definition: Added to what might normally be given or used.
additional.sentence: They used an additional sheet of paper.

address.definition: An address is the location where a building is or where a person lives.
address.sentence: He listened to an address on minor Roman poets.

adequate.definition: If something is adequate, it is good enough.
adequate.sentence: It is very hard to provide a simple but adequate explanation.

adjust.definition: If you adjust something, you change it a little so that it fits or works better.
adjust.sentence: I had to adjust the cupboard door so that is would close easily.

administration.definition: Administration is the process of running and organising an organisation such as a business or government.
administration.sentence: The mayor is responsible for the administration of the town.

admire.definition: If you admire something, you like it very much.

admit.definition: If you admit someone, you allow them to enter an area or a building.
admit.sentence: No child would ever admit to enjoying school.

adopt.definition: If you adopt something, you choose and begin to use it instead of what you used in the past.
adopt.sentence: The outcome depends entirely on the approach you adopt.

adult.definition: An adult is a person who is of the legal age of majority.
adult.sentence: Adult female cows feed milk to their offspring.

advance.definition: If something is in advance of something else, it is before it.
advance.sentence: Hotel rooms are often booked up months in advance.

advantage.definition: An advantage is a condition or circumstance that favors success.
advantage.sentence: The experience gave him the advantage over me.

adventure.definition: If you have an adventure you have a trip with a lot of excitement, hazards, or dangers.

advertise.definition: If you advertise something, you make it known publicly, usually to sell it.
advertise.sentence: Please don't advertise the fact that he has AIDS.

advertisement.definition: An advertisement is a public notice which advertises something; pictures and writing from a company which many people can see.
advertisement.sentence: There was an advertisement for fruit on the wall. It had a big picture of an apple.

advice.definition: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do.
advice.sentence: Thanks so much! I took your advice and it really helped me get the job.

advise.definition: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them that they should do it.
advise.sentence: I'd advise you to study for the exam.

adviser.definition: An adviser is a person who gives advice.
adviser.sentence: An adviser helped students select their courses.

advocate.definition: An advocate is someone who recommends something.
advocate.sentence: She is a strong advocate for children's right to education.

affair.definition: Affairs are things that happen or are done, usually that are important enough to be in the news.
affair.sentence: The whole affair with Bill Clinton was a terrible mess.

affect.definition: If x affects y, then x causes a change in y.
affect.sentence: How do you think the new government will affect the economy?

afford.definition: If you can afford something, you have enough money or resources to buy it or do it.
afford.sentence: The richer people, who could afford it, built large houses.

afraid.definition: To be afraid of someone or something means to be scared of someone or something; to have a fear of someone or something.
afraid.sentence: I'm afraid of snakes. I can't even go near them.

after.definition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time.

afternoon.sentence: He spent a quiet afternoon in the park.

again.sentence: They didn't understand the answer, so they asked again.

age.definition: Something's age is how long it has existed or been alive; how old something is.
age.sentence: The boy said he was age five.

agency.definition: An agency is a company (business) which usually represents other people. The people at the agency work as agents to represent (stand for) their customers.
agency.sentence: Our agency works to help people find jobs in music.

agenda.definition: An agenda is a list of things to be talked about, done, or otherwise dealt with.
agenda.sentence: I think there are some important domestic policy items on the agenda still.

agent.definition: An agent is a person that is a representative and acts for other people.

ago.definition: Gone by; or in the past.

agree.definition: When two people agree about something, they have the same ideas. They both think the same things are true.
agree.sentence: We agree that it will probably rain this afternoon.

agreement.definition: An agreement is where everybody has the same feelings about something; when everyone has the same ideas; saying "yes".
agreement.sentence: We have an agreement with our teacher. If we do our homework we can go home early.

agricultural.sentence: The conversions of agricultural and forest land to industrial uses is very common.

ahead.sentence: I see the lights of a town ahead.

aid.definition: Aid is the help that is given to people, usually by a government or institution.
aid.sentence: The president's aid spoke to the newspapers today.

aim.definition: An aim is something you want to do or have done.
aim.sentence: The aim of the study was to find out if these students would talk differently to themselves during independent work.

air.definition: Air is a mixture of gases. It has no color or odor (smell)

aircraft.definition: An aircraft is a flying vehicle, usually an airplane.
aircraft.sentence: The army wants money to buy various aircraft, including helicopters and jets.

airline.definition: An airline is a company that carries people and goods by means of airplanes.

alarm.definition: An alarm is a signal that something needs attention or a machine that makes the signal.
alarm.sentence: I wake up, without an alarm clock, at seven or eight a.m.

album.definition: An album is a record, tape, or CD, with many songs on it.
album.sentence: She loved to look through the family photo album and see her childhood pictures.

alive.definition: If someone or something is alive, it is living or it continues to exist. If you are alive you have life.

all.definition: If you give your all or put your all into something, you make the maximum effort possible.
all.sentence: He puts his all into every game.

allege.definition: When you allege something, you claim that it happened, even if it might not have. Usually, the word "allege" is used with doing something wrong.

allow.definition: If you allow something, you let it happen; you say it's OK.
allow.sentence: I allow food in my car.

ally.definition: Two countries are allies if they support, help, and defend each other.
ally.sentence: France got involved in World War I because its ally, Russia, was involved.

almost.definition: Very nearly; not the same, but near to being the same.
almost.sentence: I am almost ready to go. I will be ready very soon.

alone.definition: If someone is alone, they are not with other people.
alone.sentence: She looked around to make sure that she was alone before opening the desk.

along.sentence: We drove along admiring the view.

already.sentence: He was already well known, but now he's a superstar.

alright.definition: When something is alright, that means that it is in good condition.

also.definition: When one thing happens and a second thing happens in a same or similar time or way, then the second thing also happens.
also.sentence: We bought bread at the store. We also bought milk.

alter.definition: If you alter something, you change it, usually in a small way.
alter.sentence: But not even a good cleaning would alter the fact that the room was dark and unfriendly.

alternative.definition: An alternative approach, way, source, etc. is not the usual one.
alternative.sentence: Do you have some alternative transportation in case the car breaks down.

altogether.definition: You use altogether to emphasize that something was done or happened completely and in every way.
altogether.sentence: He plans to cut back on smoking slowly and not stop altogether.

always.definition: If something always happens, it happens at all times or every time.
always.sentence: For all of my life, the sun has always risen every day.

amaze.definition: If you amaze somebody, you make them feel very surprised.

amendment.definition: An amendment is an addition or change to a document; also the process of making this change.
amendment.sentence: This law can only be changed by constitutional amendment.

amount.definition: A total of things; a measure of how much.
amount.sentence: Pour a small amount of water into the dish.

analysis.definition: If you do an analysis, you study something carefully to understand it.
analysis.sentence: We performed a detailed analysis of the relationship between the two companies and believe that they could form a strong partnership.

analyst.definition: An analyst is a person who researches or studies a topic.
analyst.sentence: The company called for a business analyst to help plan the budget.

analyze.definition: If you analyze something, you study it carefully to understand it, often to see what it is made of.
analyze.sentence: They can make up questions, collect field data, and analyze that data on their computers.

ancient.definition: Very old, usually hundreds or thousands or millions of years old.

anger.definition: A strong feeling of displeasure, hostility or antagonism towards someone or something, usually combined with an urge to harm.

angle.definition: When two straight lines come together, they make an angle.

angry.sentence: He embarrassed her, so she was angry.

animal.definition: An animal is any living thing that can move. People are not animals, but are said to be animals, under the scientific definition. .

announce.definition: If you announce something, you make it public by telling people about it.

announcement.definition: An announcement is something that informs people about a topic or an issue.
announcement.sentence: The announcement in the airport told people that some airplanes would not arrive on time.

annual.definition: If something is annual, it happens every year.
annual.sentence: A border of annual flowering plants.

another.definition: Any of various alternatives; some other; entity, singular, other pronoun; quantifier, singular, another.

answer.definition: An answer is something that someone says after another person asks (says) a question.
answer.sentence: I found the answer to the mathematics exercise immediately.

anticipate.definition: If you anticipate something, you think or do something about it before it happens.
anticipate.sentence: We do not anticipate any major problems with the new system.

anxiety.definition: Anxiety is a fear of what might happen in the future.
anxiety.sentence: The thought of going to the dentist filled him with anxiety.

anxious.definition: To be anxious, you are worried or scared about what might happen in the future.
anxious.sentence: He had an anxious wait at the hospital before seeing the doctor.

any.definition: One or some or every or all without specification; entity, elective existential pronoun; quantifier, elective existential.
any.sentence: Give me any peaches you don't want.

anymore.definition: If something does not happen anymore, it happened in the past, but has stopped happening.
anymore.sentence: I liked that place when I was young, but I don't go there anymore.

anyway.definition: You use anyway to say something does not matter, or you do not care.
anyway.sentence: We were told not to go, but went anyway.

anywhere.definition: At or in or to any place.
anywhere.sentence: You can find this food anywhere.

apart.definition: Separated or at a distance in place or position or time.
apart.sentence: These towns are many miles apart.

apartment.definition: An apartment is a place with several rooms in a building where other people also live.
apartment.sentence: The woman moved her furniture into her new apartment.

apologize.definition: If you apologize, then you say you are sorry.

apparent.definition: If something is apparent, it is easy to see, realise or understand.
apparent.sentence: When she was nine, for no apparent reason, she began to dislike the classes.

apparently.definition: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard or seen, but you are not certain that it is true.
apparently.sentence: Oil prices fell this week to their lowest level in fourteen months, apparently because of over-production.

appeal.definition: An appeal is a strong or official request.
appeal.sentence: In an emotional appeal, Sevan asked the two groups to stop the fighting.

appear.definition: If something appears a certain way, it looks or seems that way.
appear.sentence: At first glance, this would appear to be true.

appearance.sentence: I tried to describe his appearance to the police.

application.definition: An application is a request for something. Often it is a paper form that you have to fill out to ask for something.
application.sentence: I have to go to the bank today to fill out an application for a loan.

apply.definition: If a rule, a principle, a law, etc. applies, it has some effect on the situation.
apply.sentence: You have to go to the government office to apply for a passport.

appoint.definition: If you appoint someone to a job or position, you give the job to them.

appointment.definition: An appointment is a formal agreement to meet or visit someone (for example, a doctor) at a certain time and place.
appointment.sentence: Let's make an appointment for lunch on Tuesday next week.

appreciate.definition: If you appreciate something, you understand its value or its qualities.
appreciate.sentence: It's hard to appreciate how difficult the job is until you try it yourself.

approach.definition: If you approach something, you move closer to it.
approach.sentence: We've got a difficult situation here, and I'm not sure how to approach it.

appropriate.definition: If something is appropriate, it matches the situation.
appropriate.sentence: We suggest ways in which teachers may change their materials to make them more appropriate for bilingual students.

approval.definition: Approval is when you formally allow something to happen.
approval.sentence: The treaty requires approval by Parliament.

approve.definition: If a person in power approves something such as a plan, a sale, a rule, etc., they say it is OK and it may go ahead.
approve.sentence: I approve of his educational policies.

approximately.definition: Approximately is close to, but not exactly.

architecture.definition: Architecture is the art of planning, designing, and constructing buildings.
architecture.sentence: He studied classical architecture and design in Rome.

area.definition: An area is a piece of land or space.
area.sentence: This is the business area of town.

argue.definition: If you argue with someone, you debate, disagree or talk about your differing ideas.

argument.definition: When two or more people are discussing an idea that they do not agree on, they are having an argument. Often arguments are loud or angry.
argument.sentence: I thought we should buy the red car. She thought we should buy the blue car. We had an argument about it.

arise.definition: When something arises, it comes up from sitting, lying, or kneeling.

arm.definition: One of the upper limbs people have; arms start at the shoulder and go down to the wrist, sometimes the hand is included.
arm.sentence: The arm of the record player.

army.definition: The people and organisation, normally in a government, which fights wars.

arrange.definition: If you arrange something, you put it in order or you organise it.
arrange.sentence: I will arrange for a car to meet you at the airport.

arrangement.definition: Arrangement is the manner of being arranged.
arrangement.sentence: The arrangement of furniture in the office was important for getting things done efficiently.

arrest.definition: If you are arrested you are caught by the police.

arrival.definition: The act of reaching the place to which you were traveling.

arrive.definition: If you arrive somewhere, you come to that place, usually the place that you planned to go to.
arrive.sentence: Is everything ready? I expect the guests to arrive soon.

art.definition: An art is a skill that produces works of creative expression and can be mastered through study and practice. Arts are often contrasted with sciences.
art.sentence: She has making baskets down to an art.

article.definition: An article is a story or report that you can read in a newspaper, journal, or online.
article.sentence: A shirt is an article of clothing.

artist.definition: An artist is someone who makes art.
artist.sentence: An artist was in the park painting the birds.

as.definition: A word that is used to compare two things that are equal.
as.sentence: You are younger than I am, but nearly as tall.

ashamed.sentence: You should be ashamed of yourself for hitting your sister.

aside.definition: An aside is something that you write or say that isn't part of your main idea.
aside.sentence: And, just as an aside, I'd like to say that these ideas are not new...

ask.definition: To ask is to look for an answer to a question by saying it.
ask.sentence: She sure does ask a lot of questions!

assess.definition: If you assess a person, idea, skill, process, etc., you judge or measure them.

assessment.definition: An assessment of a person, idea, skill, process, etc. is a judgement or measurement of them.
assessment.sentence: The results of your recent job assessment are excellent.

asset.definition: A thing that has value. It may be worth money, but may just be useful.
asset.sentence: One asset was his car and another was his house.

assign.definition: When you assign a job to someone, you tell them to do it.

assist.definition: If you 'assist someone, you help them.
assist.sentence: Nurses are available to assist the healing process.

assistance.definition: If you give someone or something assistance, you give help or support.
assistance.sentence: The company may also provide financial assistance to single mothers.

assistant.definition: An assistant is a person who helps (or assists) another person.
assistant.sentence: The doctor's assistant held his tools.

associate.definition: If you associate two things, you think of them as being connected in some way.
associate.sentence: People often associate Einstein with science, but he was also a man of peace.

association.definition: An association is a way that two things are similar, belong together, or are connected or related.
association.sentence: I don't see any association between what happened to you and what happened to me.

assume.definition: If you assume something, you think or believe something without having enough information to know that it's true.
assume.sentence: Oh, hello. I assume you're the new student, are you?

assumption.definition: A statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn.
assumption.sentence: On the assumption that he has been injured, we can infer that he will not play.

assure.definition: If you assure somebody about something, you tell them not to worry because the thing you say is true.
assure.sentence: He certainly won't be boring; I can assure you of that.

athlete.definition: An athlete is person involved in a sporting activity.
athlete.sentence: The athlete gets ready for her race.

atmosphere.definition: An atmosphere is a layer of gasses that surrounds a planet.
atmosphere.sentence: There was an atmosphere of excitement.

attach.definition: If you attach x to y, you put x on y so that they will not come apart.
attach.sentence: Attach the wire to the speaker with the red clip.

attachment.definition: Attachment is the process of being attached.

attack.sentence: The visiting team started to attack.

attempt.definition: An attempt is a try at something, usually something difficult.
attempt.sentence: It's broken and no attempt has been made to fix it.

attend.definition: If you attend something like school or a party, you go to it.
attend.sentence: My son will attend kindergarten next year.

attendance.definition: If you are attending something, you are in attendance for that event.
attendance.sentence: Attendance at the meeting is required.

attention.definition: If you pay attention to something, you focus your mind on it.
attention.sentence: Pay attention to me when I'm speaking to you.

attitude.definition: Your attitude is your feelings and opinions, especially when your actions show how you feel.
attitude.sentence: He has a really bad attitude towards work.

attract.definition: If something attracts you, it makes you interested in it.
attract.sentence: She jumped up and down to attract attention.

attraction.definition: An attraction is a force that pulls two things together.
attraction.sentence: Magnets have an attraction to metal.

attractive.definition: If people or things are attractive, you like them because you think they are good, beautiful, etc.
attractive.sentence: People buy the make-up and stuff they see on television to make them appear more attractive.

attribute.definition: If you attribute x to y, you say that x is the creation or result of y.

audience.definition: An audience is the person or people who watch a performance, listen to you speak, or read what you write.
audience.sentence: The audience at the concert was dancing on their chairs.

aunt.definition: Your aunt is the sister of your mother or father.

author.definition: An author is the creator of a work; a writer.
author.sentence: I am the author of this article. I was the one who wrote it.

automatically.definition: If something happens automatically, it happens without the need for a person to start it or do anything more.
automatically.sentence: The door closed and locked automatically behind him.

autumn.definition: The season when the weather is getting cooler, after summer and before winter.

available.definition: If something is available, it exists and you can use it.
available.sentence: We can't answer the question with the available information.

average.definition: To be average is to be not one extreme or another.
average.sentence: In football, he is an average player.

avoid.definition: When you avoid something, you stay away from it or you don't do it.
avoid.sentence: You can't avoid doing your homework.

award.definition: An award is something that you give to someone who has done something very well.

aware.definition: If you are aware of something, you know about it.
aware.sentence: I am fully aware of the need for security, and will make the necessary changes.

awareness.definition: Awareness is the state of consciousness, or the state when someone is awake. It means that a person can sense changes in their environment and respond to it.
awareness.sentence: I gradually passed from sleep to full awareness.

away.definition: From a particular thing or place or position (‘forth’ is obsolete)

awful.definition: Very bad. So bad that people don't want to think about it.
awful.sentence: When all the children were crying, it was just awful.
